description: This Java class EvaluateEcuDefinition retrieves ECU definitions from a map based on an ECU ID, returning a default 'unknown' definition if none is found.

classes.name: EvaluateEcuDefinition
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve ECU definitions based on ECU ID.

methods.name: getDef
methods.description: Retrieves the ECU definition for a given ECU ID from the provided map, returning a default 'unknown' definition if not found.
